d: Chestnut brown hair falls to the mid-back with a side-swept fringe and a single braided lock draped over the shoulder. Sharp, almond-shaped blue eyes peer through thin-rimmed glasses on a youthful, mature face. The slim build is dressed in a black pleated mini-skirt, a black top with a red tie, and a long white open coat with red lining and silver buckles, paired with sheer black tights and white heeled boots. Accessories include a black choker, black fingerless gloves, a thigh holster, and a black submachine gun.
